module.title: UI: Helper: Relations
module.description:
Lists item relations.
Can be used for confirmation views to enlist entities related to an item.
Uses hooks to retrieve information about related items from other modules.
To append entities, you need to implement Hook::listRelations.
Rendering supports two modes: list> - list: simple list for small views - table: table for large views <list
module.log: Rework to match view helper interface.
Support method chaining on view helper class.
Add entities for module relation and its items.
